text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука has held onto her lead
over Air
Groove!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Look at her go! The Otherworldly
Front-Runner
has left the Empress in her
wake!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You're so awesome, Suzuka! You're the
best!
text_block_list.name: Male Fan

text_block_list.text:
What a race, Suzuka! I'll always be
watching you
from the stands!
text_block_list.name: Female Fan

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: (I... lost again...)
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ngh.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You were... incredible. You completely
outclassed
me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm really happy that I got to
race with
you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: It was an honor. Next time...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Yes?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: It's... nothing.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Next time... victory will be mine.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I don't intend to lose either.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for our next race.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
As we leave the racecourse, Эйр Грув's

expression is more grave than I've ever
seen it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka truly was incredible. She was
beautiful,
unbound, and... powerful.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Everyone was enraptured by her.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...Including me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: The way she ignited the crowd...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
That kind of feat is... far beyond me
right now.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув is clearly deflated. I
desperately try to
think of something to
say...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Please... Don't make that face.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
We've still got training tomorrow. Slow
and
steady, just like normal.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
For the time being, the race we need to
aim for is
the Sapporo Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Yes... that should do, shouldn't it?
There's
nothing you need to worry about
anymore.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...I'm going back ahead of you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув dashes off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've never seen Эйр Грув like this
before...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
